200.description:
Filtered data query on any Eurostat dataset through the statistics/1.0 JSON-stat endpoint. Filters are dimension id -> list of codes (OR within a dimension); time is sliced with time, since and until. The sparse JSON-stat cube is flattened into one observation per cell with the codes of every dimension, the value and the Eurostat status flag. Requests that are too large for a synchronous answer fail with upstream_error (413 ASYNCHRONOUS_RESPONSE): narrow the filters.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `observations` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | object | Dimension id -> code for every non-time dimension of the dataset (freq, geo, unit, ...). Keys are the dataset's own dimension ids. |
| `status` | string | Eurostat flag as stated (e = estimated, p = provisional, b = break in series, ...). |
| `time` | string |  |
| `value` | number | Null when Eurostat publishes only a status flag (e.g. ':' not available) for the cell. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
